id: 第二章-善恶篇-杜子春-四-p1

en: 第二章-善恶篇-杜子春-四
Before long, the two of them came down on Mount Emei riding on bamboo staffs.
u.src: 不多一会儿，两人乘着竹杖在峨眉山降落。

en: It was an enormous boulder, with a bottomless abyss below,
u.src: 那是一块无比巨大的岩石，下面是万丈深渊，

en: The ground here must have been extremely high, for the Big Dipper hung far away in the sky,
u.src: 这里的地势想必非常的高，北斗星遥挂天上，

en: its starlight glittered so brightly that it seemed almost as large as a tea bowl.
u.src: 星光璀璨，看上去竟然和茶碗的大小差不多。

en: This was deep in the mountains, where people rarely came, and everything around was silent,
u.src: 这里本是人迹罕至的深山，四周寂静无声，

en: the only sound to be heard was the old twisted pine growing on the sheer cliff behind him, shuddering and roaring in the night wind.
u.src: 耳朵里能听到的声音，也只有身后绝壁上生长着的一棵虬曲老松在夜风中呼呼颤动的声音。

en: The two men came up onto the rock, and Tieguanzi ordered Du Zichun to sit below the sheer cliff, then said:
u.src: 两个人来到岩石上面，铁冠子吩咐杜子春坐在绝壁下方，说：

en: I am going up to heaven first to visit the Queen Mother of the West,
u.src: “我等下要先去天界拜访西王母，

en: so sit here for the time being and wait for me to return.
u.src: 你暂时坐在这里等我回来。
我不在的时间里，

ja: こうとするかもしれない。
en: some demonic obstacles may appear beside you and try to deceive you.
u.src: 可能会一些魔障出现在你身边，想要骗你。

en: No matter what happens, you must remain silent and not make a sound.
u.src: 不管发生什么事情，你都得默不出声。

en: You must understand that if you utter even a single word,
u.src: 你要明白，只要你说出一个字，

en: you will never again have the chance to become an immortal.
u.src: 你就再也没机会成仙了。
知道了吗？

en: Even if the heavens collapse and the earth splits open, you must keep silent and say nothing.”
u.src: 就算是天塌地陷，你也要缄默不言。”

en: Please rest assured, I will not say a single word.
u.src: “您放心好了，我肯定会一言不发的。

en: Even if I die, I will remain silent.
u.src: 就算是死，我也会缄默不言。”
“真的？
那我就放心了。

en: I will be back very soon.”
u.src: 我很快就会回来的。”

en: After saying farewell to Du Zichun, the old man climbed back onto his bamboo staff, flew up over the mountains, and vanished without a trace in an instant.
u.src: 老人家跟杜子春告别之后，又跨上竹杖，飞上群山上空，瞬间消失的无影无踪。

en: Although the night was hazy at that moment, the steep mountain peaks could still be seen faintly.
u.src: 此刻虽然夜色缥缈，但是也能依稀看见陡峭的山峰。

en: Du Zichun sat alone on a rock, silently gazing at the distant stars.
u.src: 杜子春一个人坐在岩石，寂静的望着遥远的星宸。

en: After about half an hour had passed, the chill of the deep night began to pierce through his clothes, making him shiver; just then, a scolding voice came from the sky:
u.src: 大约过了半个时辰的样子，深夜的凉气开始穿透人的衣裳，令人瑟瑟发抖，恰在此时，空中传来训斥声：
“是谁？”

en: Du Zichun strictly obeyed the immortal's words and did not utter a sound.
u.src: 杜子春谨遵仙人的话，一声不吭。

en: After a while, that voice came again; this time it was a fierce threat:
u.src: 过了一会儿，那个声音又来了，这次是厉害的的恐吓：

en: If you don't speak, I'll kill you right now.
u.src: “你要是不说话，我就立刻要了你的命。”

en: Du Zichun remained silent and said nothing.
u.src: 杜子春依然缄默不语。

en: At that moment, a fierce tiger came running out from somewhere and suddenly leapt onto the rocks,
u.src: 这个时候，不知道从哪里跑出来一只猛虎，突然跃上岩石，

en: The tiger's eyes blazed with life as it glared down at Duzichun and let out a long roar.
u.src: 老虎的眼睛炯炯有神，睥睨这杜子春，发生一阵长啸。

en: Just then, the pine tree overhead also suddenly began to tremble,
u.src: 恰在此时，头顶的松树也突然颤动起来，

en: and from the top of the sheer cliff behind him appeared a huge white python,
u.src: 身后的绝壁顶上来了一条白色的大蟒蛇，

en: this python flicked a tongue of flame from its mouth, and its body was as thick around as a four-dou wine cask,
u.src: 这蟒蛇口吐火焰舌，腰围足有四斗酒桶一样粗，

en: and in the blink of an eye it was about to crawl right to Duzichun's feet.
u.src: 眼瞅着既要爬到杜子春脚下了。

en: But Du Zichun still sat upright with perfect composure, without so much as raising an eyebrow.
u.src: 但是杜子春依然泰然自若的端坐，眉毛都没有抬一下。

en: After a short while, the fierce tiger and the giant python both stared at him without moving, as if waiting for the perfect moment to seize their prey, when suddenly,
u.src: 约莫过了片刻，猛虎和巨蟒都盯着他一动不动，好似在寻找成熟时机展开捕食，突然，

en: they leaped at Toshishun at the same time.
u.src: 它们同时扑向了杜子春。

en: Would he be torn apart by the fierce tiger, or swallowed by the giant python?
u.src: 究竟是被猛虎撕碎，还是被巨蟒吞噬？

en: Toshishun's life hung by a thread, but just at that moment, the fierce tiger and the giant python both vanished like mist.
u.src: 杜子春命在旦夕，可是恰在此时，猛虎和巨蟒都像雾气一般消散了。

en: Behind him, only the pine tree on the sheer cliff still trembled in the wind.
u.src: 身后依然是只有绝壁上的松树在风中颤动。

en: Toshishun let out a long breath. Would anything else happen?
u.src: 杜子春长舒了一口气，还有有什么事情发生吗？

en: He focused his mind and waited.
u.src: 他凝神等着。

en: Just then a sudden gale swept up, dark clouds pressed heavily over everything, the darkness was split open by pale purple lightning, and thunder crashed all around.
u.src: 这个时候突然刮起了一阵狂风，乌云黑压压的笼罩了四周，黑暗被淡紫色闪电从中劈开，雷声交加。

en: No, it was not only lightning and thunder; a torrential downpour came pouring down.
u.src: 不，不光是电闪雷鸣，倾盆暴雨倾泻而下。

en: Heaven and earth changed color, the whole world trembled, yet Toshishun sat upright as if he were not afraid.
u.src: 天地变色，宇内震动，杜子春却似乎不害怕的端坐着。

en: Amid the fierce wind, sudden rain, lightning, and thunder, even towering Mount Emei seemed about to be overturned in an instant.
u.src: 疾风骤雨，雷电交加，就是这巍巍峨眉山，似乎也要瞬间翻天覆地了。

en: At that moment the thunder rumbled so violently that it seemed almost ready to pierce a person's eardrums,
u.src: 这个时候，雷声轰隆隆，几乎要穿透人的耳膜，

en: and from the churning black clouds in the sky, a pillar of fire shot out and rushed toward Toshishun's head.
u.src: 空中翻动的乌云中窜出一条火柱，冲向杜子春头顶。

en: Toshishun instinctively covered his ears and lay flat on the rock.
u.src: 杜子春不由自主的捂住了耳朵，趴在岩石上。

en: But when he opened his eyes and looked again, the sky had returned to its former state, cloudless for ten thousand miles,
u.src: 可是，等他睁开眼睛再看时，天空又恢复如初，万里无云了，

en: Above the towering mountain peak, the Big Dipper hung far away in the sky, shining brilliantly.
u.src: 高耸的山峰上面，北斗星遥挂天上，熠熠生辉。

en: Seeing this, he realized that the fierce wind and sudden rain, the savage tiger, and the giant python just now must all have been tricks played on him by the demons after they noticed Tieguanzi was gone.
u.src: 这么一看，看来刚才的疾风骤雨、猛虎巨蟒一定都是魔障们发现铁冠子不在，捉弄自己的恶作剧了。

en: Toshishun calmed down, raised his sleeve to wipe away his sweat, and then continued sitting upright on the rock.
u.src: 杜子春心定了下来，抬袖拭了拭汗，继而继续端坐在岩石上。

en: But before his uneasiness had fully subsided,
u.src: 但是，他的心虚还未完全平复，

en: another heavenly general appeared before his eyes,
u.src: 眼前又出现了一个天将，

en: this figure was thirty feet tall, clad in golden armor, and awe inspiring in bearing.
u.src: 这人身长三丈、披着金铠，威风凛凛。

en: This heavenly general held a trident in his hand,
u.src: 这天降手持三叉戟，

en: and the tip of the weapon suddenly thrust toward Du Zichun's chest,
u.src: 戟尖突然戳向杜子春的胸膛，

en: as he glared furiously and said:
u.src: 怒目瞪视道：
你是何人？

en: Ever since the world was created, this Mount Emei has been my own solitary dwelling.
u.src: 从开天辟地之后，这峨眉山就是我独居之处。

en: For you to barge into Mount Emei all by yourself, you must be no ordinary person.
u.src: 你一个人竟然闯进峨眉山，一定不是什么等闲之人。

en: Hmph, if you want to keep your life, answer me at once!”
u.src: 嘁，你要是想要保全性命，就速速回话！”

en: Du Zichun carefully obeyed the old man's words and did not say a single thing.
u.src: 杜子春谨遵老人的话，一声不吭。
“不说话？

en: How dare you refuse to speak!
u.src: ——竟敢不说话！

en: Fine, if you will not speak, then have it your way!
u.src: 好，你要不说话，那也随便你！
来人，杀了他！”

en: The heavenly general raised his trident high and gave a sweep toward the sky above the mountain peak opposite him.
u.src: 天将高高的举起三叉戟，向对面山顶的天空一晃。

en: Astonishingly, the darkness was torn open in an instant, and countless heavenly soldiers filled the whole sky in ranks; the swords and spears in their hands gleamed as they surged toward Du Zichun like a tide.
u.src: 让人不可思议的是，黑暗瞬间被撕破，无数天兵列队占满整个天空，他们手中的刀枪熠熠发光，潮水般涌向杜子春。

en: Seeing this scene, Du Zichun almost spoke, but he immediately remembered Tieguanzi's words, forced himself to hold back, and did not say a word.
u.src: 看见这幅景象，杜子春几乎要说话出来，但他立马想到了铁冠子的话，使劲绷住，一声没吭。

en: Seeing that he was utterly fearless, the heavenly general was furious and shouted:
u.src: 天将见他毫无畏惧，气愤异常，喊道：

en: You stubborn little wretch, since you have decided never to open your mouth, I will grant you your wish.
u.src: “你这顽固鼠辈，既然你决定死不开口，那我便成全了你。”

en: Before the voice had even faded, the trident descending from the heavens pierced Du Zichun to death.
u.src: 声音未落，天降的三叉戟便刺死了杜子春。

en: Then laughter from the heavens echoed among the slopes of Mount Emei, and in an instant vanished again without a trace.
u.src: 接着，天降的笑声回荡在峨眉山间，转瞬便又消失无踪。

en: Needless to say, by then those countless heavenly soldiers had already been scattered by the night wind until no sign of them remained.
u.src: 不用多说，这时候那无数的天兵也已经随着夜风，被吹散的无影无踪。

en: The Big Dipper shone brightly, scattering its light over the whole mountain peak, while the pine trees on the sheer cliff still trembled faintly in the wind.
u.src: 北斗星熠熠生辉，洒满整个山峰，绝壁上的松树依旧被风吹得微微颤动。

en: But Toshishun was already lying on the rock with his face turned toward the sky, dead.
u.src: 但是，杜子春却已经面朝天空躺在岩石上，死了。
